name: bridge-theme
description: A sci-fi starship console theme: pitch black, flat pastel frames, a star-field you fly through, world clocks

clocks.title: World clocks
clocks.description: Comma-separated time zones, each optionally labelled, e.g. "Sydney=Australia/Sydney, Europe/London, UTC". Up to 8.

pagerdutyServer.title: PagerDuty MCP server
pagerdutyServer.description: The name of your PagerDuty MCP server, as `claude mcp list` shows it.

primarySchedule.title: Primary on-call schedule ID
primarySchedule.description: PagerDuty schedule ID for the primary on-call (for example P1ABCDE). Leave empty to hide the ON CALL block.

secondarySchedule.title: Secondary on-call schedule ID
secondarySchedule.description: PagerDuty schedule ID for the secondary on-call.

incidentScope.title: Escalations to show
incidentScope.description: Open high-urgency incidents for your teams, everyone, or only those assigned to you.
